rows.description: An overhead close up view of a small black colored frog being cupped in a person's hands. The frog is cupped in the person's right hand, their left hand is on the left side of the right hand creating a wall preventing the frog from jumping forward. The frog is facing the top of the image toward the person's left hand. The person's wrists and hands are extending from the top and bottom left corners of the image. The person's gray shirt is visible in the middle of their wrists on the far left side of the image.

A close up right side view of a motorcycle rider performing an extreme trick while jumping through the air, the rider is facing towards the right. The rider has their bottom and legs directly over the front fender, their arms reaching back, holding onto the handlebar. The rider is wearing a green uniform and the color of the motorcycle is black and white. Behind the rider is a stadium of people sitting down, spectating the rider.

An angled top-down view is seen of someone holding a clam close up. The white shells of the clam are being held by both hands of the person holding the clam up to show the brown wire growths along the edge of the shells. The person's shirt is seen behind the clam view. They are wearing a black long-sleeve shirt with a graphic of a black and white cat in a space costume, with small rainbow stripes that cross the cat's costume like suspenders. They wear blue jeans, with their feet unseen in the image. The ground below looks like a mix of large rocks, green water, and beige sand, and their shadow reaches across to the upper right of the image. The angle of the shadow suggests a late afternoon scene.

An indoor backside view of a person doing maintenance on a large fish tank in an aquarium. The person is fully submerged into the water and is wearing a black scuba-diving suit, there is a small silver cylindrical shaped tank attached to the person's back. The person has their legs spread out with each foot placed against two separate rocks. The person is facing towards a large beige colored boulder rock, and their hands are placed on the rock. The top surface of the water can be seen just above the person's head. There is light shining down into the water from above its surface.

An outdoor close up view of an arm with hand pouring a dark red metal insulated bottle out on the pavement. The bottle has the text,"Google" printed on its side in bold white letters. The liquid being poured from the bottle is forming a small thick looking puddle on the concrete. The concrete has a texture and appears pea green in color. At the very top of the frame is a small stick on the concrete and beyond that, some grass in the upper right.

An outside view of a busy street with multiple vehicles. A black BMW is driving behind a black bus on the right side of the road. The bus has a small canopy built in over it. People are seen sitting on top of the bus underneath the canopy. The tail light of a black vehicle is seen to the right of the image. A white SUV is in front of a white box truck on the left side of the road. A black and yellow building is seen on the left side of the road as well. A red sign is hanging on the side of the black and yellow building. A large cone-shaped base made of glass is seen behind the black and yellow building, with a metal structure on top of it. Altocumulus clouds are seen in the blue sky above the area. The top portion of a castle structure is seen in the background on the right side of the image.

Two white and blue planes parked on a gray cement runway. The planes are facing away from each other. The left sides of the planes have navy blue text that reads "jetBlue". The nearest plane is in a three quarters position facing the bottom right corner of the image. The further plane is facing the top left corner of the image. There is a blue and white plane tail visible on the left side of the image in the distance. There are thick cumulus clouds in the sky covering most of the top half of the image. There are two people wearing orange vests to the right of the nearest plane, the person on the right has both arms up directed toward the plane. There is a white cart in front of the planet.

An outdoor nighttime view of a large body of water consisting of many people rowing yellow canoes on its surface, the canoes all have lights on them making them easily visible. Behind the body of water and to the right is a tree line that consists of medium sized bushy trees, to the right of the tree line are tall buildings are different shapes and sizes, one of the buildings is very lit it up and its light is reflecting off of the body of waters surface.

A long-shot view of Downtown Las Vegas with multiple cars stopped at a traffic light. There is a large, shadowed area on the left side covering the cars. The middle of the street is lit by the sunlight. A light gray pedestrian bridge is above the cars, with multiple people walking across it. The entrance stairs are on the left side. It has clear glass walls. There are palm trees spread around the area behind the bridge. There's a large black billboard on the left side behind the bridge. A large, white building, with many windows and a sign with the word "hollywood" in yellow letters, is seen behind the pedestrian bridge. The Hard Rock Cafe is in the top-right corner.

A long shot wide angle view of an airport apron area with a large white, blue and red Delta Airbus A321 in the center with a man in a high visibility orange shirt walking towards the head of the plane. Four empty luggage trailers sit in the blurred foreground. Three tall black metal light poles stand behind the airbus. The skies are clear and grey. Dark treetops line the distant background.
